data.body:
## Summary

Add `linux/riscv64` as a d2vm platform, following the arm64 support (linka-cloud/d2vm#44): riscv64 is added to the existing platform switches, templates and release list, with no new file, template or CI job.

## Changes

- **build / convert**: `--platform linux/riscv64` is accepted. As on arm64, the bootloader defaults to `grub-efi` and only `grub-efi` is allowed (the `syslinux`, `grub-bios` and `grub` bootloaders need x86 BIOS boot).
- **templates**: the Debian and Ubuntu templates pick the `grub-efi-<arch>-bin` package from `dpkg --print-architecture` instead of the `x86_64`-else-`arm64` mapping, and the Debian template picks the kernel package from it instead of a hardcoded `linux-image-amd64`. Package names are unchanged on amd64. On arm64 Debian images the kernel package is now `linux-image-arm64` instead of `linux-image-amd64`, which is an intended fix.
- **run/qemu**: `d2vm run qemu` supports the riscv64 `virt` machine. On riscv64 the `-bios` slot holds the SBI firmware, so the UEFI firmware given with `--bios` is attached as a read-only pflash drive. The `rv64` CPU model is used when not running on a riscv64 host.
- **docs**: the flag help lists riscv64 (and now reads `linux/amd64, linux/arm64 and linux/riscv64` instead of `linux/arm64 and linux/arm64`), the README install snippet maps `riscv64` hosts to the riscv64 tarball, and the CLI reference is regenerated with `make cli-docs`.
- **goreleaser** (separate commit): `riscv64` is added to `goarch`. `windows/riscv64` and `darwin/riscv64` are listed in `ignore`: goreleaser would skip these invalid pairs anyway, the list only makes the excluded combinations explicit.
- **tests** (separate commit): `debian:11` is dropped from `TestConfig`. bullseye-security has moved to archive.debian.org and the packages its index lists return 404 on deb.debian.org, so every `debian:11` case fails on `main` as well. Earlier end of life releases were dropped the same way in 113541c.

## Testing

- The project CI workflow (`.github/workflows/ci.yaml`) passed on this exact tree.
- `make check-fmt`, `make docs-up-to-date` and `make build-snapshot` (which now also builds `linux_riscv64`) pass locally.
- In a `linux/riscv64` container: `go build`, `go vet` of the changed packages, the unit tests that do not need a Docker daemon (`TestImageFlatten` was left out) and a compile of the e2e tests.
- Under emulation on an amd64 host, with a local riscv64 variant of the e2e test that is not part of this PR: `ubuntu:24.04` and `debian:13` converted with `--platform linux/riscv64` and booted to the login prompt in QEMU with the edk2 riscv64 firmware, for every e2e case that applies to grub-efi (with grub-efi d2vm always uses a separate fat32 boot partition), LUKS included.
- With the final series, `ubuntu:24.04` converted for riscv64 (with `--boot-size 250`, see Notes) and booted to the login prompt.
- `TestConfig` for ubuntu and debian passes on amd64 without `debian:11`; the `debian:11` failure reproduces on `main`.
- No riscv64 job is added to CI, in line with arm64, which has none: everything is built and tested on x86 by default.

## Notes

- With the default `--boot-size 100`, converting `ubuntu:24.04` for riscv64 fails, because the uncompressed riscv64 kernel (about 47 MB) and the initrd (about 51 MB) do not fit in the boot partition. `--boot-size 250` works. The default is unchanged here.
- Alpine is not supported on riscv64 yet: `linux-virt` is not built for riscv64, and the `linux-lts` kernel did not reach a console in testing.
- The README install snippet downloads `d2vm_<version>_linux_riscv64.tar.gz`, which exists only from the first release that includes this change.

commits.message:
feat: add linux/riscv64 platform support with grub-efi

* build / convert: accept `--platform linux/riscv64`, defaulting to
and only allowing the grub-efi bootloader as on arm64
* templates: select the grub-efi package on debian and ubuntu, and
the kernel package on debian, from the dpkg architecture; on arm64
debian images this now installs linux-image-arm64 instead of
linux-image-amd64, amd64 is unchanged
* run/qemu: support the riscv64 virt machine, loading the UEFI
firmware from pflash and using the rv64 cpu model when not running
on a riscv64 host
* docs: list riscv64 in the flag help, the README and the regenerated
CLI reference

Signed-off-by: riseproject-upstreaming[bot] <359135081+riseproject-upstreaming[bot]@users.noreply.github.com>

goreleaser: add riscv64 to the release architectures

Only linux/riscv64 is released: windows/riscv64 and darwin/riscv64 are
not Go ports, so they are listed in ignore. goreleaser would skip these
invalid pairs anyway, the list only makes the excluded combinations
explicit.

Signed-off-by: riseproject-upstreaming[bot] <359135081+riseproject-upstreaming[bot]@users.noreply.github.com>

tests: drop end of life debian 11 from the templates tests

Debian 11 reached the end of its LTS support: bullseye-security moved
to archive.debian.org and the packages its index still lists return 404
on deb.debian.org, so every debian:11 case of TestConfig fails, on main
as well. Earlier end of life releases were dropped the same way in
113541c (chore: update distro releases).

Signed-off-by: riseproject-upstreaming[bot] <359135081+riseproject-upstreaming[bot]@users.noreply.github.com>
